name: Salmorejo (Spanish Chilled Tomato Soup)

ingredients.name: ripe tomatoes, cored and roughly chopped
baguette white bread, torn into bite-sized pieces
sherry vinegar, plus more to taste

instructions.primary_message: In a blender, combine tomatoes, bread, garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar, and salt. Blend on high speed until completely smooth and creamy, 1 to 2 minutes. For a punchier soup, season with an additional 1/8 teaspoon sherry vinegar.
Transfer salmorejo to an airtight container and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 30 minutes.
To serve, portion salmorejo into individual bowls. Top with hard-boiled eggs, jamón serrano or ibérico, and a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil. Serve cold.

description: This cold, creamy Spanish tomato soup blends ripe tomatoes, bread, garlic, sherry vinegar, and olive oil into a quick and bright summer meal.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 35 min.

Optional substitutions: baguette white bread → rustic white bread; Chopped jamón serrano → ibérico

Notes: Jamón serrano, a dry-cured Spanish ham, is the more affordable and widely available option. Jamón ibérico, made from Iberian-breed pigs, has more intramuscular fat, giving it a richer flavor and texture that nearly melts on the tongue. For the most complex, nutty flavor, look for jamón ibérico de bellota, made from pigs that forage on acorns. Spanish specialty shops, well-stocked cheese counters, and online retailers often carry both serrano and ibérico; either works well here.

Make-ahead and storage: Leftovers can be refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 4 days.
author: Laila Ibrahim
